headline: Grupo Acerero Advances Plan to Substitute Imports and Strengthen Domestic Supply
summary: GASA bought all its plate slab from third parties in 2025 and expects about 63% of its plate production to use its own raw material by the end of 2026, as part of an import-substitution plan.
why: Grupo Acerero is a Mexican steel producer, and shifting to own raw material reduces reliance on imports and purchased slab.
original_headline: Grupo Acerero avanza en plan para sustituir importaciones y fortalecer la oferta nacional
